frame:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent production Minecraft tooltip nine-slice frame texture. NOT a concept illustration. New replacement for an overly noisy feather frame.
Make one square RGBA sprite on a genuinely transparent canvas. Design on a 96x96 logical pixel grid, visibly crisp pixel art intended to be read at 1:1 game size. Master can be 1024x1024 but limit detail to the equivalent of 96x96 pixels, with no subpixel fine details. Nine-slice boundaries at 25% and 75% of canvas (logical x=24/72, y=24/72). Center square between these boundaries must be EMPTY TRANSPARENT.
Only FOUR corner motifs: each corner is exactly THREE LARGE broad raven feathers, long pointed oval silhouettes with a single bold shaft highlight and two or three large shading planes. Absolutely no tiny barbs, no filigree, no thorn branches, no little curls, no spikes, no dense overlapping feather rows. Each individual feather should be at least 5 logical pixels wide and 14 logical pixels long and obvious at small game size. Upper-left feathers sweep outward UP and LEFT, upper-right feathers sweep UP and RIGHT. Lower-left feathers sweep DOWN and LEFT, lower-right feathers sweep DOWN and RIGHT. Clear directional fan shape, graceful, few strong forms.
The four middle edge strips MUST NOT contain repeating feather motifs or center emblems: just a very thin 1-2 logical pixel muted purple rail with sparse gold accent, continuous and straight, located DIRECTLY against the inner opening. The top rail lies at logical y=23 just above the transparent opening starting y=24. Bottom rail y=72. Left rail x=23, right rail x=72. These rails connect naturally to the base of the four feather fans. There must be NO transparent gap between the rail and the logical central square boundary, since the rail must touch the black vanilla tooltip rectangle in game. Outside the rail, the middle strips are entirely transparent. No rectangle background fill.
Palette: predominantly deep violet #321153, amethyst #7423b6 and restrained bright purple #ac46db, small lilac highlights #ce8fe8, with sparse antique gold #c69248 and soft gold #e5b96b. NO near-white neon dots, NO hot pink glitter, NO glow mist. Pixel-game-art shading with a dark violet outline. The bossbar reference image is for the broad overlapping feather shape ONLY; do not copy the helmet/crystal/head/halo.
No lettering, no numbers, no checkerboard painted in, no screenshot, no logo, no face, no filigree, no wreath, no small thorny repeated details. Strong simple feather silhouettes are essential. No top center crest in this image, as it is a separate sprite.
crest:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one transparent Minecraft tooltip TOP CENTER feather crest sprite, intended to render at 72x24 GUI pixels. NOT a complete border or an illustration.
Generate a wide horizontal isolated ornament on actual transparent background. Artwork should fill a 3:1 rectangle and be flat pixel art with the equivalent of a 72x24 pixel grid. Master may be large, but no detail finer than one logical pixel; no antialiasing, no fine noisy filigree.
Design: a small simple antique-gold lozenge/diamond at exact center, framed by ONE symmetric fan of broad purple raven feathers. Exactly THREE LARGE feathers on each side: their roots meet at the center, and their long tapered feather tips sweep LEFT and UP on the left half and RIGHT and UP on the right half. Overall wings open from the center toward outer sides. The lower bases form a nearly horizontal line so the crest rests directly on the upper edge of a black tooltip rectangle. Each broad feather has just one simple gold or lilac shaft highlight and two or three flat planes of purple shading, with NO tiny barbs or curls. The silhouette should read as clear upward-open feather wings at 72x24, with a small gold diamond accent. The middle crest is singular and special; no repeats, no surrounding frame. The reference bossbar supplies broad layered feathers only; exclude its huge face, helmet, crystal, shoulder armor and halo.
Palette exactly matches a restrained violet feather frame: deep violet #321153, amethyst #7423b6, bright purple #ac46db, limited lilac #ce8fe8, sparse antique gold #c69248 and soft gold #e5b96b. Purple dominates. No neon-white pixels, no magenta sparkles, no thorn spikes, no filigree, no floating particles, no glow cloud, no opaque background, no fake checkerboard, no text, no numbers, no watermark.
Ensure actual transparency. Compact bold shapes, a readable decorative silhouette at real game size.
